newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SEOUL UPS CREDIT GUARANTEE LIMIT FOR KIA SUPPLIERS.
newsitem.headline: SEOUL UPS CREDIT GUARANTEE LIMIT FOR KIA SUPPLIERS.

text.p: South Korea's finance ministry said on Tuesday it was raising the individual credit guarantee ceiling for subcontractors of Kia Motors Corp and Asia Motors Corp to 500 million won from 200 million.
Subcontractors of the two troubled automakers would now be able to raise money more easily by discounting commercial paper issued by Kia and Asia Motors, a ministry statement said.
The finance ministry action would enable subcontractors to get credit guarantees from domestic institutions when they seek to discount commercial papers issued by Kia and Asia.
The extended ceiling, which compares to the uniform 100 million won limit for all small- and medium-sized companies, would be effective until September 29, the statement said.

But the ministry rejected the Small and Medium Business Administration's request for 350 billion won in special loans to finance discounting of more Kia-related commercial papers owned by small- and medium-sized companies, a ministry official said.
It was the second time the ministry raised the credit guarantee ceiling after it extended the limit to 200 million won late last month.
Kia and Asia are core units of the Kia Group, which has been put under protection by banks until September 29 after it ran into financial troubles under 9.54 trillion won in debts.
The ministry statement said 511.5 billion won worth of commercial papers issued by Kia and Asia were due to mature in August and September.
